[BEDWARS]
[+] Added AntiMagma, which strips the touch transmitters off magma so it can no longer kill you
[+] Added InviteSpam, which invites everyone in the server and tells you who joins or leaves the party
[+] Added FastPickup, which picks up drops faster than the game's own pickup rate
[+] Added KillauraV2, the rebuilt aura with Fast Hits, Fast Hit projectiles and its own swing cadence
[^] SilentAim gains an FOV circle, AutoCharge with a charge percentage, a range slider and a randomised body part with head/torso chances
[^] CheatDetector now runs on a per-player score with Speed, Reach, Killaura, Fly and AntiDeaths toggles that each gate their own check
[!] Fixed SilentAim doing nothing: it called a helper that does not exist, so every shot it tried to redirect threw
[!] Fixed CheatDetector doing nothing: its poll loop called a helper that does not exist, so no check ever ran
[!] Fixed Killaura's Custom Animation: the missing animation library threw during setup, which also meant Limit to items and Swing only were never created

[GENERAL]
[^] Version 3.13.0
